goal: Let external mining coordinators validate custom block templates against Bitcoin Core's mempool
Eliminates the need for external mining services to maintain duplicate mempool mirrors
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Avoids redundant mempool synchronization and reuses existing block validation logic (enirox001)
Verified by running the test suite and checking coinbase construction (jeanpablojp)
Concept approval without stated reasons (ismaelsadeeq, pablomartin4btc)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because external mining coordinators no longer need to maintain duplicate mempool mirrors
Saves substantial memory and IPC bandwidth for Stratum v2 Job Declarator Servers
Also enables decentralized mining protocols to efficiently reconstruct and validate candidate blocks
